name: stub_return_only
description: Returns immediately without touching any state, so it is an empty handler.

name: store_two_longs_in_record
description: Copies the D4 and D5 register values into two 32-bit fields of the record addressed by D2, 56 and 60 bytes in.

name: increment_global_byte_by_index
description: Adds one to a byte of the global array selected by the D0 word index.

name: update_entry_table_proximity
description: Walks a fixed table of 64-byte entries, skipping invalid or flagged ones, and calls per-entry update routines for active entries. An entry whose coordinates lie within 5000 units of a reference entry gets a status bit and a handler call.

name: scan_entries_for_proximity
description: Walks the same entry table and applies a per-entry flag test, then a proximity test with a 5000-unit limit. Passing entries get a status bit and a handler call, and entries flagged for removal have a state byte cleared.

name: mark_targets_in_range
description: Clears a status bit on every table entry, then walks up to 100 target indices. Invalid or hidden targets are dropped, and targets within a squared-distance limit lose one from a counter in their record and get a status bit set.

name: resume_target_range_scan
description: Continues the target-list walk from the current position with the same validity, range and counter checks, overwriting invalid list slots with -1.

name: advance_target_range_scan
description: Steps to the next target-list slot and returns when the count runs out. Skipped slots are negative or hidden, and in-range targets get a status bit set.

name: update_entry_status_flags
description: Copies a status bit from the entry's flag word into an active-state bit, and sets a further state bit according to two other flags.

name: stub_return_only
description: Returns immediately without touching any state, so it is an empty handler.

name: store_value_in_free_slot
description: Searches a 100-entry signed word table for the first negative (free) slot and stores the D0 value there. It returns silently when the table is full.

name: commit_entry_position_or_candidate
description: Sets a state byte from the entry's flags, then either copies pending coordinates into the current ones and sets a settled flag, or, when a candidate flag is set, picks the candidate with the lowest key and clears its search flag.

name: choose_lowest_key_candidate
description: Walks a candidate list for the entry with the lowest key and records it on the entry. If there is no candidate, it copies the pending coordinates into the current ones and sets a settled flag.

name: compute_scaled_squared_distance
description: Takes the absolute x and y differences between two points, divides each by 1000, and returns the sum of their squares.

name: check_entry_action_cooldown
description: Compares the time since an entry was last stamped with a threshold picked by a type byte. When ready, it stamps the entry, sets its active bit, and decrements a shared counter.

name: stamp_entry_when_cooldown_expires
description: Compares a stored value with a threshold passed in D1. Below the threshold it marks the entry, decrements a shared counter and sets an active flag; otherwise it stamps the entry with the current counter and clears the flag.

name: check_code_without_effect
description: Compares the D0 word with a constant and returns either way, so the comparison result is discarded and nothing changes.

name: select_highest_ranked_slot
description: Scans a nine-slot pointer list for the largest value among three ranked fields of ordinary entries or a fourth field of flagged entries, records a pointer to the winning field, and calls two routines when a winner exists.

name: resume_highest_ranked_selection
description: Continues the same ranked selection over the remaining slots from a given position, then calls two routines if a winner was recorded.

name: find_minimum_key_match
description: Walks a linked list until its null terminator, keeping the entry with the smallest key that matches a stored code value, and stops early when a flag test passes.

name: scan_list_for_lowest_key
description: Walks a linked list and tracks the lowest key among entries whose code matches a stored value, stopping early when a flag test passes. It returns the final key pair.

name: initialise_scan_cursor
description: Stores the current position in the object and sets four status words to fixed constants, then walks a list comparing values until the list end is reached.

name: stub_return_only
description: Returns immediately without touching any state, so it is an empty handler.

name: walk_word_list_subtracting
description: Walks a list of words from a start pointer, subtracting each stored word from a value taken from the object's list head, and returns once the value reaches zero or goes negative.

name: record_event_in_free_slot
description: Places a value into the first free slot of one of two small tables. Code 69 goes to a seven-slot table with a scaled distance value and a caller-supplied value, and other codes below 72 go to a slot table of three-word records. Codes of 72 or more are not stored.

name: relink_and_compact_entry_table
description: Updates each entry's link to its next position and clears child slots that are marked finished. Entries whose chain has ended and that carry a finished flag are removed by shifting the rest of the table down.

name: relink_entry_table_from_position
description: Performs the same relinking and compaction as the full table routine, but its first pass starts from a given pointer rather than the start of the table.

name: advance_entry_or_compact_table
description: Walks the entry table, clearing finished child slots and advancing each entry's link. Entries with no further link and a finished flag are removed by shifting the table, and the next link is stored into the entry.

name: select_adjacent_grid_cell
description: Looks up an entry's cell in a 6000-unit grid table and picks the neighbouring cell nearest the target coordinates, returning scaled grid coordinates for that cell.

name: convert_grid_cell_to_coordinates
description: Converts two grid cell indices in D0 and D1 to world coordinates by multiplying each by 6000, with the first also offset by one more cell.

name: find_nearest_rectangle_to_point
description: Scans a table of rectangles whose size is given in its header and computes the squared distance from a point to each rectangle's nearest edge. It keeps the closest match in globals and returns the point itself when it lies inside a rectangle.

name: scan_rectangles_for_nearest_edge
description: Continues the rectangle scan from a given rectangle, measuring squared distance to each rectangle's edges and remembering the nearest one. It stops early when the point lies inside a rectangle.

name: scan_rectangles_for_nearest_point
description: Another variant of the nearest-rectangle scan, starting from a given rectangle pointer and updating the nearest-match globals when it finds a closer rectangle.

name: lookup_code_from_table
description: Maps the indices 5, 6 and 7 to fixed codes 67, 68 and 69, and otherwise reads a word from a two-dimensional table indexed by both inputs, with the second input doubled and 142 replaced by 76.

name: read_table_word_by_index
description: Returns the word stored in the global table at the offset given by D0.

name: throttle_entry_update_by_stamp
description: Performs one update step only when enough time has passed since the entry's stamp. It then re-stamps the entry, subtracts 200 from the stamp and floors it at zero.

name: refresh_cached_slot_value
description: Returns a cached value if it was refreshed less than 200 ticks ago. Otherwise it recomputes it from a small per-slot table, checking the entry's type byte against a threshold.

name: test_point_in_rect_discard
description: Tests whether the point in D4 and D5 lies inside the rectangle at the record pointed to by A0, but the result is discarded and the routine returns in every case.

name: trigger_pending_action_once
description: Sets a flag, and when the object's pending counter is negative it triggers an action using a per-slot table value and resets the counter to zero.

name: clear_flag_and_trigger_action
description: Clears the flag, then triggers the same pending action as the sibling routine when the counter is negative, and resets the counter to zero.

name: trigger_table_action_if_pending
description: When the object's pending counter is negative, it sets a flag and triggers an action using a value from a per-slot table at the given base, then resets the counter to zero.

name: reset_pending_action_counter
description: When the object's pending counter is negative, it sets a flag, calls two routines and clears the counter. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: store_scaled_slot_table_value
description: Looks up a byte in a five-byte-stride table for the object's current slot, doubles it, and stores the result in a global word.

name: store_scaled_previous_slot_value
description: Stores a byte from the previous slot's table entry, scaled by another value, into a global word.

name: compute_weighted_chain_score
description: Computes a weighted score from table bytes for the current slot, the summed values along a linked chain, and a ratio of accumulated totals. It clamps the result, stores it, and increments a counter.

name: compute_weighted_chain_score_alt
description: Performs the same score computation as its sibling, but stores the chosen value in a separate global slot.

name: store_clamped_quotient_with_counter
description: Divides an input by a byte from the object record, clamps the quotient to 12, and records it. A zero quotient stores a sentinel, and any other value increments a counter.

name: initialise_alt_scan_record
description: Stores the current position in the object's scan record and sets four status words to constants. It is a variant of the scan setup with different status values.

name: pass_through_after_call
description: Calls one routine and then returns the D0 and D1 register pair unchanged on both branches, so it has no visible effect of its own.

name: increment_flag_selected_counter
description: Chooses a counter array, either a default or one from a matching list entry, and increments the byte selected by a bit field in the entry's flags. Entries of type 140 use a fixed index.

name: increment_counter_from_bits
description: Increments a byte in the given record at an index taken from a bit field of the D1 flags, using a fixed index for code 140.

name: run_music_player_main
description: Program entry point: sets the task priority, initialises the music player, installs the interrupt, waits for the end signal, then restores the interrupt and shuts the music player down.

name: wait_for_fire_button
description: Polls the CIAA_PRA register and returns as soon as the fire bit reads low. Otherwise it keeps polling only while the POTGOR right-button bit is high, then returns.

name: configure_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Writes a fixed sequence of values to the CIA-B control and interrupt registers, sets the timer high and low bytes, and stores the interrupt handler address.

name: restore_cia_interrupt_state
description: Writes a fixed value to the CIA-B interrupt control register, restores a saved word, and writes a small fixed value to the DMA control register.

name: set_current_task_priority
description: Calls the Exec library to find the current task, then calls it again to set that task's priority.

name: acknowledge_interrupt_and_play_music
description: Interrupt handler that touches the interrupt request register and calls the music playback routine. The pseudo-code is unavailable, so only those register accesses and that call are known.

name: stub_infinite_empty_loop
description: Contains an empty loop that never exits, so it never returns. The facts list a read of the vertical beam position register, but the body does not use it.

name: advance_music_song_position
description: Runs the per-channel command routine for each of the four channels, then steps the song position forward, wrapping at 128 and reloading a stored value when it matches.

name: process_channel_note_and_effect
description: Reads the next four-byte note entry for one audio channel, loads its sample, period and volume from tables, and applies the effect command: position jump, pattern break, speed change, or volume set.

name: apply_channel_non_looping_effect
description: Advances one channel's note state for a non-looping sample, sets its sample pointer and volume, and dispatches the effect command to the portamento, stop or speed and volume handlers.

name: apply_stopped_channel_effect
description: Applies a channel's effect command from its effect nibble: fine volume, pattern break, position jump, speed change or volume set. Other effects are ignored.

name: set_portamento_target_and_effect
description: Sets a channel's portamento target from its note period and direction flag, then applies the same effect dispatch as the other channel handlers.

name: clear_portamento_speed
description: Zeroes the channel's portamento speed word.

name: slide_period_toward_target
description: Applies one portamento step to a channel's period. It latches a new slide speed when one is given, moves the period up or down toward the target, clamps at the target, and writes the result out.

name: step_portamento_period
description: Performs one portamento step on a channel's period without latching a new speed, moving toward the target and writing the result out.

name: subtract_period_with_clamp
description: Subtracts the D0 amount from a channel's period, clamps at the target value, and writes the result to the output period.

name: apply_vibration_step
description: Applies one vibration step. It latches a depth when one is given, reads a sine table at the channel's phase to get an offset, adds it to the period, writes the result, and advances the phase.

name: apply_vibration_without_latch
description: Applies one vibration step using the depth already stored for the channel, adding the sine offset to the period and advancing the phase.

name: write_offset_period_and_advance
description: Writes the difference between two inputs to the channel's output period, then advances the vibration phase by the upper nibble of the depth byte.

name: select_arpeggio_period
description: Selects an arpeggio note by searching the period table for the first period not below the channel's base period, then offsetting it by a nibble of the effect byte. If no arpeggio is set, it outputs the base period.

name: select_arpeggio_period_low
description: Performs the same period search as the arpeggio routine, using only the low nibble of the effect byte as the offset.

name: output_found_arpeggio_period
description: Writes the period table entry at the located index, offset by the D0 amount, to the channel's output period.

name: output_base_period
description: Copies the channel's base period to its output period without changing any state.

name: dispatch_channel_effect
description: Dispatches a channel's effect command by its effect nibble to the arpeggio, portamento, vibrato, volume slide or set-volume handlers and returns the resulting value. When no effect is set, it outputs the base period.

name: slide_pitch_up_clamped
description: Lowers the channel's period by its slide amount, clamps it at the minimum period of 113, and writes it to the output period.

name: slide_pitch_down_clamped
description: Raises the channel's period by its slide amount, clamps it at the maximum period of 856, and writes it to the output period.

name: apply_vibration_and_volume_slide
description: Runs a vibration step and then a volume slide. The upper nibble of the parameter raises volume up to 64, otherwise the lower nibble lowers it toward zero, and the result is written to the output volume.

name: apply_portamento_and_volume_slide
description: Runs a portamento step and then a volume slide. The upper nibble of the parameter raises volume up to 64, otherwise the lower nibble lowers it toward zero, and the result is written to the output volume.

name: slide_volume_down
description: Lowers the channel's volume by the low nibble of its effect parameter, floors it at zero, and writes it to the output volume.

name: apply_non_slide_channel_effect
description: Applies the effect commands that do not slide pitch: filter, pattern break, position jump, speed and set volume. All other effects are ignored.

name: set_filter_bit_from_parameter
description: Sets bit 1 of the global mirror of the CIAA_PRA register from the low bit of the effect parameter.

name: request_pattern_break
description: Sets the song position variable to 1, the value used to request a pattern break.

name: jump_to_song_position
description: Sets the song position variable to one less than the effect parameter.

name: set_channel_volume
description: Clamps the effect parameter to a maximum of 64 and stores it as the channel's volume and output volume.

name: set_playback_speed
description: Sets the playback speed from the effect parameter, clamped to a maximum of 31 and raised to 1 when it is zero.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to bad instruction data that halts, so this label holds no usable routine. The label is referenced as a variable address elsewhere.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to bad instruction data that halts, so this routine has no usable behaviour.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to bad instruction data that halts, so this routine has no usable behaviour.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to bad instruction data that halts, so this routine has no usable behaviour.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to bad instruction data that halts, so this routine has no usable behaviour.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to bad instruction data that halts, so this routine has no usable behaviour.

name: start_program_main_loop
description: Program entry point: stores initial pointers and values in globals, calls several setup routines, then loops forever calling two routines.

name: read_file_and_close_libraries
description: Opens a DOS file, reads from it, closes the file, and closes the library. If the open fails, it closes the library and returns an error value.

name: write_file_and_close_library
description: Opens a DOS file and writes to it when the open succeeds, then closes the file and the library. When the open fails it closes the library and returns an error value.

name: open_dos_library
description: Opens dos.library through Exec's OldOpenLibrary and stores the returned base in a global.

name: fetch_io_error_and_close
description: Reads the DOS I/O error code, closes the file handle and the library, and returns a failure value.

name: setup_graphics_interrupt_state
description: Forbids task switching, opens graphics.library, saves one of its words and replaces it with a handler address, then writes enable values to the interrupt and DMA registers before closing the library.

name: handle_audio_channel_interrupts
description: Interrupt handler that checks the request bits for the first two audio channels in the interrupt request register. Channel 0 stores a status value and clears its request, and channel 1 restores a saved pointer, calls a routine and counts the event.

name: count_flagged_interrupt_event
description: When bit 5 of the D0 value is set, restores a saved pointer, calls a routine and increments a counter. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: initialise_table_and_delay
description: Fills a seven-group table of word pairs with fixed values, waits in a nested countdown loop, and writes two fixed values into a second table when a flag is set.

name: wait_for_interrupt_then_enable
description: Polls the interrupt request register until bit 5 is set, then writes the value that re-enables that same interrupt bit in the interrupt-enable register.

name: split_bitplane_pointers
description: Splits a base address into four bitplane pointers spaced 8000 bytes apart and stores the high and low words of each in separate globals.

name: permit_task_switching
description: Calls the Exec library's Permit routine to re-enable task switching and returns the register pair unchanged.

name: release_task_switching_lock
description: Calls Exec's Permit routine to re-enable task switching, then returns the register pair unchanged.

name: forbid_task_switching
description: Calls Exec's Forbid routine to disable task switching and returns the register pair unchanged.

name: run_selected_handler_or_halt
description: Calls a library routine and, when it returns nothing, forbids task switching and loops forever. Otherwise it closes the library and calls the handler selected by the returned index from a small table.

name: restore_graphics_field_and_write
description: Opens graphics.library, stores a saved value in one of its fields, and writes a short text string to DOS output.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to bad instruction data that halts, so this routine has no usable behaviour.

name: expand_nibbles_into_buffer
description: Splits a 32-bit input into eight nibbles and writes eight bytes into a global buffer, each one looked up in a table indexed by its nibble.

name: deinterleave_image_into_bitplanes
description: Copies a four-plane image from a staging buffer, skipping a 128-byte header, into four separate bitplane buffers by moving one word from each of four interleaved positions per step across 4000 words.

name: deinterleave_image_with_setup
description: Performs the same four-plane de-interleaving copy as its sibling, skipping the leading setup calls.

name: allocate_frame_buffers
description: Allocates one memory block through Exec and carves four sub-buffers from it at offsets 32000, 64128 and 88704 bytes, storing each address in a global.

name: free_frame_buffer_block
description: Frees the memory block through Exec's FreeMem routine and stores the returned value in the block pointer global.

name: execute_strikeiv_program
description: Executes the strikeiv.prg program through DOS, then closes the library.

name: decompress_lzss_stream
description: Decompresses an LZSS-style stream. It fills a 4096-byte ring buffer with spaces, then reads flag bits that select literal bytes or back-references into the ring, writing output until the count is exhausted.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset in the base record into the buffer passed in, when one is provided, then calls a second routine.

name: run_assign_program_entry
description: Program entry for the assign command. It scans a linked list for the largest field value, prepares a buffer with a header, copies sixteen longwords into it through a routine, and returns zero on success or minus one on failure.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset in the base record into the buffer passed in, when one is provided, then calls a second routine.

name: run_iconx_program_entry
description: Program entry for the iconx command. It allocates a process record, opens dos.library and the file named in its arguments, parses the command line into arguments with quoted strings and escape sequences, then invokes a routine and frees its resources.

name: release_process_resources_and_return
description: Stores the parameter as the task's saved value, closes the open file and library handles when present, forbids and replies to a message when present, frees the record memory, and returns the saved value.

name: set_up_icon_console_window
description: Looks up an icon in icon.library, sets the default delay, allocates a 1536-byte buffer for the console window, and reports a shortage of memory when the allocation fails before releasing library resources.

name: run_icon_request_handler
description: Builds a command buffer from a handler table entry and the request text, then runs the request. A reply that is a single dot triggers follow-up calls, and a wait or end-of-CLI command may be appended.

name: create_library_with_functions
description: Creates a library from a descriptor structure, builds its function table, and enables the result before returning it.

name: parse_icon_path_string
description: Walks a linked list of name nodes, building a path string from entries longer than a threshold, then replaces the first slash with a colon. It allocates a 260-byte scratch buffer and frees it before returning.

name: copy_strings_then_call_offset
description: Copies one string to a second destination and a second string to the first, then calls a routine with an offset computed from the routine's own return value. The routine is unnamed, so its exact purpose is not visible.

name: count_string_length
description: Returns the number of bytes before the terminating zero in a zero-terminated string.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer until a null terminator has been copied.

name: skip_string_then_call
description: Advances a pointer to the zero byte that ends a string, then calls a routine with that pointer and the second argument unchanged.

name: parse_signed_decimal
description: Parses a signed decimal integer from a zero-terminated string, accepting an optional plus or minus sign and stopping at the first non-digit.

name: call_with_stack_slot
description: Calls a routine with the two parameters it receives, plus a pointer to a fixed stack slot.

name: format_text_and_send
description: Formats text into a 140-byte stack buffer through the library's RawDoFmt routine, measures the string length, and passes the buffer and length to a routine when the string is not empty.

name: call_raw_format_routine
description: Invokes the library's RawDoFmt routine through the global library base and returns.

name: store_byte_at_output_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of D0 to the address held in A3. It serves as the character output callback for the formatting routine.

name: run_disk_validator_main
description: Program entry of the disk-validator tool. The visible part formats a number into a status line, initialises a table of block markers, and tests bits of a bitmap table. The pseudo-code is truncated, so the full check cannot be confirmed.

name: initialise_system_then_loop
description: Program entry for the second loader: stores a plane pointer and a register value in globals, calls setup routines, then loops forever calling two routines.

name: fill_table_pairs_and_delay
description: Fills two tables of word pairs with fixed values, waits in a nested countdown loop, and when a flag is set writes two fixed pointer-like values into several global slots.

name: store_bitplane_word_pointers
description: Splits a base address read from a record into four bitplane pointers spaced 8000 bytes apart, storing each as high and low words in two sets of globals.

name: combine_bitplane_masks
description: Copies a block of 480 longwords, then for four rows of 24 words combines three bitplanes with bitwise logic to derive mask words. The masked and inverted results go into separate buffers.

name: service_audio_channel_requests
description: Checks the request bits for the four audio channels. For each pending channel that is not busy, it writes zero volume and a channel bit to the audio and DMA registers, then clears the request.

name: queue_audio_channel_sample
description: Selects a free audio channel record for the requested sample, copies its pointer and length into the record, and sets its start address and volume. It returns early when audio state is busy or the request is not valid.

name: start_pending_audio_channels
description: Loops over four audio channel records and, for each one flagged active and matching the current id, loads its sample address, length, period and volume into the channel's hardware registers, enables its DMA bit, and clears its flag.

name: open_and_read_file_retrying
description: Opens a DOS file, repeating the open until it returns a handle, then repeats the read until it succeeds, then closes the file and the library.

name: close_file_and_library
description: Closes the DOS file and the library, then returns the value passed in.

name: open_write_and_close_file
description: Opens a DOS file and writes to it when the open succeeds, then closes the file and the library. A failed open or write closes the handles and returns.

name: open_dos_library_base
description: Opens dos.library through Exec's OldOpenLibrary and stores the returned base in a global.

name: report_io_error_and_close
description: Reads the DOS I/O error code, closes the file and library, and returns a failure value.

name: open_and_examine_file
description: Opens a file and examines it, storing part of the examined result when both calls succeed. If either call fails it closes the handles and the library.

name: decode_raw_keyboard_code
description: Decodes a raw keyboard code from the keyboard serial register into a character through a key table, ignoring released keys and recording two special codes in a flag.

name: clear_special_key_flag
description: Clears the special-key flag when the low seven bits of the key code are 96 or 97.

name: install_graphics_handler_state
description: Opens graphics.library, saves one of its words and replaces it with a handler address, writes enable values to the interrupt and DMA registers, then closes the library.

name: restore_graphics_interrupt_state
description: Writes clear masks to the DMA and interrupt control registers, restores two saved values, then writes the enable value again.

name: handle_channel_interrupt_queue
description: Interrupt handler that acknowledges the first audio channel request. For the second, it stores a returned value in a 32-entry ring buffer, increments a counter, and computes a status byte from the input register.

name: handle_input_interrupt_queue
description: Variant of the channel interrupt handler that takes its flags from D0 and a record value. It stores into the same ring buffer and computes the status byte from the record and the input register.

name: update_mouse_position_deltas
description: Converts the change in the mouse counter into signed deltas and adds them to two position values. Each is clamped to a range, with a minimum taken from a record field, and the new counter is stored.

name: update_mouse_position_deltas_entry
description: Same mouse delta update as its neighbour, entered with the counter already loaded from the caller.

name: store_mouse_counter_and_clamp
description: Stores a new counter value from D0, adds an adjusted delta from D2 to the position with sign correction, clamps the ranges, and updates the second position.

name: update_mouse_port_position
description: Reads the mouse port counter in JOY0DAT, computes the change since the last reading, and updates the horizontal and vertical position values with clamping.

name: clamp_mouse_position_values
description: Adds a signed delta to a position word, clamps it to a range, raises it to a minimum from a record field, and caps the vertical value at 304.

name: clamp_mouse_position_limits
description: Clamps a position word to the record-derived minimum and to 184, and caps the vertical value at 304.

name: forbid_task_switching_passthrough
description: Calls Exec's Forbid routine to disable task switching, then returns the register pair unchanged.

name: swap_buffers_then_wait
description: Disables interrupt bit 5, swaps two stored pointers and sets a flag word, waits until the interrupt request bit 5 is set, then re-enables bit 5.

name: wait_for_interrupt_then_reenable
description: Polls the interrupt request register until bit 5 is set, then writes the value that re-enables that interrupt bit.

name: match_tag_and_decode
description: Checks a 16-byte tag in a buffer against a stored pattern. On a full match it decodes numeric fields from the bytes before the tag into globals and clears a counter, otherwise it calls a reset routine.

name: match_tag_decode_alt
description: Same tag match and field decoding as its neighbour, writing the decoded values into a different set of globals.

name: match_tag_decode_second
description: Same tag match and field decoding as the routine before it, with a separate set of destination globals.

name: match_tag_decode_third
description: Same tag match and field decoding as the routine before it, with a separate set of destination globals.

name: match_tag_decode_fourth
description: Same tag match and field decoding as the routine before it, with a separate set of destination globals.

name: dispatch_queued_handler_entry
description: When the queued handler index differs from the read index, calls the handler from a 32-entry table and advances the index with wraparound. It triggers the reset path when the entry equals 97 and a flag is zero.

name: store_value_in_record_field
description: Stores its stacked argument in a fixed field of the record. The decompiled body shows only that store, not the Exec Supervisor call the facts list.

name: reset_and_jump_to_restart
description: Calls the reset routine and then jumps to a fixed low address, without returning.

name: start_blitter_copy_operation
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its masks, modulo values, source and destination pointers and control registers from the record, then starts a blit of the set size.

name: start_simple_blitter_copy
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its masks, control registers and pointers from the record, then starts a blit of the set size.

name: build_timed_entry_text
description: Looks up a table record, derives a timing value by adding fixed increments for each count, copies up to 16 entries into a buffer, writes decimal digits into a text line, and waits before returning.

name: decompress_lzss_into_record_buffer
description: Performs the same LZSS-style decompression as its sibling, filling a 4096-byte ring buffer with spaces and writing the output into a buffer offset from the record.

name: update_timed_slot_entries
description: Decrements timers on a record and advances or retires entries in a 12-byte-stride list of up to 16 slots, calling routine routines as entries expire. The decompiled body is truncated, so only this outline is certain.

name: format_three_digit_number
description: Writes a number as three ASCII digits in a buffer, hundreds first, and uses a marker to blank out a leading zero.

name: draw_tile_into_four_bitplanes
description: Copies a tile of 16 columns by 21 rows into four bitplane buffers, looking up a per-pixel mask and writing one byte to each plane at each step.

name: update_slot_selection_flags
description: Marks entries in a 12-byte-stride list with a selection flag where their id matches the current slot, then clears the flags of entries whose stored values have changed.

name: advance_frame_state_machine
description: Handles the per-frame state for the active object: counts down several timers, updates the current selection and displayed status, and calls drawing routines when a condition holds. The decompiled body is truncated, so only part of the logic is shown.

name: start_text_sequence_entry
description: Selects a text sequence by index, records its pointer and start time, then steps through its entries, calling routines for each one until the terminator byte is reached.

name: start_text_sequence_without_flag
description: Starts a text sequence by index with the same stepping loop as its neighbour, without the initial position update.

name: add_digit_pattern_to_string
description: Adds a stored pattern of digits to an eight-character decimal string with carry, wrapping each digit modulo ten and writing it back as an ASCII digit.

name: subtract_digit_pattern_from_string
description: Subtracts a stored pattern of digits from an eight-character decimal string with borrow, wrapping each digit modulo ten and writing it back as an ASCII digit.

name: subtract_digit_pattern_variant
description: Performs the same decimal subtraction with borrow as its neighbour on an eight-character string.

name: step_timed_sequence_until_end
description: Waits for each timer tick in turn and calls two routines per step until the sequence pointer reaches a zero terminator.

name: draw_text_glyphs_into_bitplanes
description: Reads the next word of a sequence and, for each character of a string, either blanks eight rows for a space or draws an eight-row glyph into four bitplanes using a lookup table.

name: advance_sequence_and_pause
description: Reads the next word of a sequence, records a stored value when it hits the end marker, then calls a routine eleven times.

name: call_routine_twenty_one_times
description: Calls one routine 21 times in three groups of seven, with no other work.

name: fill_rows_when_state_changes
description: When the current and target state values differ, counts the frames spent, calls a routine during the first three frames, and after that fills a 72-row column strip with solid bytes for eight or nine columns.

name: fill_column_strip_with_byte
description: Fills a 72-row column strip in the bitplane with the byte passed in D1, for eight or nine columns, starting at a table offset chosen by the index in D0.

name: build_spec_display_screen
description: Sets up a display screen by copying image and table data into the bitplane buffers and clearing a sprite-style table. It then selects one captioned text entry by index and copies its text into the display buffer.

name: interleave_bitplanes_to_buffer
description: Reads four bitplanes at fixed offsets and writes their words interleaved into a single buffer, 84 rows of seven words at a time.

name: deinterleave_buffer_into_bitplanes
description: Reads an interleaved buffer and writes its words back out to four separate bitplanes, 84 rows of seven words at a time.

name: run_display_update_loop
description: Initialises display buffers and entry lists from tables, then runs a per-frame loop that updates entries and text fields until its frame counter reaches zero.

name: initialise_display_bitplanes
description: Sets bitplane pointers from the record, copies an image through a routine, expands a nibble-indexed table into four bitplanes, and fills a 256-entry word table with inverted patterns.

name: draw_text_glyphs_alt
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into the bitplanes with one eight-row glyph per character and a blank strip for a space. It is the same glyph routine as its sibling.

name: draw_masked_bitplane_rows
description: Combines source rows with per-plane masks selected from the state index and writes the combined words into four bitplanes, four rows of eight words each.

name: initialise_sprite_table_and_enable
description: Initialises the sprite records: fills a 16-row mask table with alternating words, copies per-entry sprite data into the buffers, sets default position values, then re-enables interrupt bit 5.

name: read_fire_update_display
description: Reads the fire and right-button bits from the CIAA_PRA and POTGOR registers to update a direction value, then updates the displayed position and timers and runs a text update when the state changes.
